run.name: Final validation of receive, payments and history

step.name: amount
step.text: pick E2ED, type the max amount, pick Hide amount

tags.changed: Its own test, or its feature, changed
tags.failed: Failed the last time it ran
tags.owed: Something shared changed that may reach it
tags.fresh: Last passed with exactly what is here
tags.stale app: Its last result was on an app not built from these sources
tags.skipped: The kit can't run it yet

messages.text: Full run to end the work on receive, payments and history: the last check of a change to the suite. Every scenario must pass on one commit before the baseline ledger is written.
This is the second start. The first (16:31, 50 passed, 7 failed) was thrown away: the fund helper made two transactions in one second and broke one group's setup. Fixed in a1ce8fd1.
Nothing to watch here. fn/receive-payment is next; its locked and broken-key groups spend about 4 min each on setup before the first result.
A fee token can't be created while all the HTR is private: "shielded balance equation does not hold". Seen in the app; nothing filed.
